nature: organizational design for software project stewardship; no technical mechanism change proposed
eligibility: first ordered document satisfies part/purpose, two constraints and alternatives; retain rather than choose more technical lower-ranked problem
part_and_purpose: Move the selected web-oriented Executable Books repositories into a sustainable, neutral Jupyter Book subproject while leaving the other repositories separately governed.

conditions.meaning: Transferred repositories should integrate/interoperate with other Jupyter projects and follow Jupyter standards/protocol strategy.
Non-transferred repositories remain under Executable Books governance; Jupyter assumes neither responsibility nor oversight for them.
conditions.quote: will not have any responsibility or oversight

boundary.input: A JavaScript-based repository outside Executable Books, exemplified by Papyri, is proposed for inclusion.
boundary.expected_in_original: Do not add it to this decision merely because it uses JavaScript; the current incorporation is limited to existing Executable Books repositories.

open_choices.choice: Standalone community under a fiscal sponsor
Retain current GitHub organization and governance without formal organizational status

known_alternatives_and_references: Earlier Voila and Xeus incorporation JEPs
MyST migration strategy (linked Google document, not opened)
JupyterLab-MyST, JupyterHub/Binder/JupyterLite, Sphinx/docutils, MyST, Papyri and NBConvert already named
origin_layer: earliest repository blob; creation-time draft unproven
